about: Remediation level 2 (FINAL Module 5): curated compensating controls per hardening change. Each entry comes from a lab measurement in this repository, names its source, and is a suggestion until tested. The student curates this file; order is the ranking. Match: change_id equal, and technique one of the blind techniques or null for the whole change.

controls.control: The LSASS dump attempt is still seen at process start after LSA Protection: rule 92032 (level 3, procdump.exe) and rule 92027 (level 4, PowerShell spawning PowerShell) fired in both LSASS trial runs. Candidate: raise the alert level for process starts whose command line targets lsass.exe (procdump, comsvcs.dll MiniDump, rdrleakdiag), so the attempt is not left at level 3 to 4.

controls.control: With NLA on, a client that skips the password check is refused with no logon event and no alert; only Sysmon event 3 (TCP to port 3389) records it, and no shipped rule reads it. Candidate: alert on inbound connections to port 3389 from hosts not expected to use Remote Desktop.
